calls.summary: Talked about her garden and her late husband Shankar, who planted the mango tree.

turns.text: Yeh aam ka ped Shankar ji ne lagaya tha, shaadi ke pehle saal.
Kitni sundar yaad hai, Kamala ji. Ab bhi us ped par aam aate hain?
Haan, har garmi. Unki bahut yaad aati hai.

calls.summary: Started telling the story of her first train journey to Calcutta; the call dropped midway.

memories.text: Her late husband Shankar planted the mango tree in her garden in their first year of marriage
memories.quote: Yeh aam ka ped Shankar ji ne lagaya tha

memories.text: Kamala ji tends a small garden every morning
Leela visits for tea most evenings
